title: The other key
logline: The two keys on the ring, close: one the shack's, cut and worn; the other older, a different shape, for a door the sequence never draws. The page ends the mill on the key it doesn't explain.

panels.composition: Extreme close-up of two keys on a ring on a nail: one a worn brass door key, the other older and a different shape, the shingle wall behind.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, in the Era I manner, heavy black spotting brought back on purpose, an extreme close-up of two keys on a ring hanging from a nail, one a worn brass door key and the other older and differently shaped, shingle wall behind, no words
